data.actions#Actions: The forge serves the gitea-runner protocol so that the existing runner runs our jobs unchanged. Registration tokens are single-use, short-lived and bound to one runner name; a job’s token is scoped to its repository and job and revoked when the job ends; secrets are never sent to runs triggered from forks. Runners are created by GARM, first through its gitea forge type, later through a govcs type to be contributed to GARM.
data.administration#Administration: Everything administrative goes through one gRPC API, and the web UI has no admin page the API lacks. Authentication is a FIDO2 credential on a hardware key with user verification. Enrolment verifies the attestation against FIDO MDS3 and accepts only allowlisted AAGUIDs, with no opt-out. Each mutating call carries a fresh assertion over a challenge that combines a server nonce, the hash of the exact request message and a TLS exporter value of the connection, so an assertion is valid for one request on one connection.
data.design#Design: A summary of forge/docs/design.md, which is the authoritative text (draft of 2026-11-25) and cites the source it read for every claim. Where the two differ, the design document wins.
data.git-transport#Git transport: SSH and smart HTTP, protocol v2 only for fetch. Push policy is decided in-process by parsing the receive-pack command list and pack with gitproto before any ref moves: there are no server-side hooks and no internal callback token.
data.identity#Identity: Web sign-in goes only through the go-authn bridge (OIDC), with a client restricted to the bridge’s local accounts. The forge implements no passwords. A sign-in whose issuer and subject are not bound to an existing account is refused: it never creates an account and never links to a signed-in session. SSH push and pull use per-user SSH keys, preferably FIDO-backed sk- keys.
data.milestones#Milestones: gitproto: pkt-line, protocol v2 capability advertisement, ls-refs and fetch, with fuzzers and a benchmark against git upload-pack. forge: storage layout, accounts, admin gRPC API with FIDO2 assertions and its CLI; SSH and HTTP clone. The admin API and CLI (2a) are implemented. forge: OIDC sign-in through the bridge, read-only web UI. gitproto and forge: receive-pack with in-process push policy. actions: workflow planning, runner protocol server, GARM gitea type. Pull requests and reviews in the web UI. GARM govcs forge type; artifacts.
data.status#Status: Milestone 2a, the admin gRPC API and its CLI, is implemented. The rest is not.
data.three-repositories#Three repositories: Repository Holds gitproto Git wire protocol v2 (upload-pack, receive-pack), pkt-line, pack files and indexes. A library with no forge knowledge, fuzzed and benchmarked against git. actions Workflow parsing and planning (matrix, needs, expressions) and the server side of the gitea-runner protocol. Reusable without the forge. forge The server: storage, accounts, permissions, SSH and smart HTTP transports, web UI, admin gRPC API and its CLI, webhooks, the GARM-facing API.
